messages:
Tara (Events): Going live in 8 — recorder node 3 is throwing disk errors, swapping to backup recorder now. mic check in 5?
ops-bot: alert: recorder-3 disk I/O error detected at 1766207885
Jamal (Eng): On it. SSH-ing into recorder-2 and prepping failover. command: ```ssh ubuntu@recorder-2 && sudo systemctl start redwood-recorder-backup```
Brynn (AV): Can you also flip captions source to captions-secondary? OBS scene will break if we swap feeds mid-deck.
Jamal (Eng): Doing captions switch now: ```/usr/bin/captions-switch --to secondary``` — will ping when done.
Jamal (Eng): captions switch succeeded. :white_check_mark:
Tara (Events): Awesome. Also quick roadmap Q for leadership: will the March infra spend include more Dedicated zones? need a one-liner for the product slide.
Eve (CEO): Short answer: yes — committed to two more regions this quarter (eu-west-2, ap-south-1). We'll attach the final slide after the all-hands and follow up in #product.
Jamal (Eng): Backup recorder live, ingest moved to recorder-2. OBS should reconnect in ~10s.
Brynn (AV): Verified stream health & local recording good. OBS reconnect success on my end.
Tara (Events): Mic check — @Jamal can you confirm ingest audio levels look normal? I hear a low hum on the feed.
Jamal (Eng): Levels nominal, hum looks like Presenter Mic B picking up laptop fan. Recommend swap to headset. @Alex could you swap to headset?
Alex (Presenter): Swapped to headset, hum gone. :thumbsup:
Tara (Events): For Q&A workflow: if a question needs follow-up from product/security, please tag #post-allhands and prefix with "followup:" so we can triage.
Brynn (AV): small note — captions on secondary are about ~6s behind live. call this out during intros so we don't get confused.
Eve (CEO): Thanks — will mention caption latency and where folks can switch caption sources in the player.
Tara (Events): Recording wrap plan: we'll stop recording +1min after applause to capture handoffs.
ops-bot: recording: started backup-recorder-2 at 1766207905
Jamal (Eng): initiating archive snapshot and will stop live recording in 60s.
Tara (Events): Thanks all. Post-allhands actions: Jamal to upload raw feed to /internal/allhands/raw, Brynn to produce three highlight clips, Eve/Product to circulate updated roadmap slide. I'll post assignments in #post-allhands. :wave:
